title: Best HR Software in Malaysia for SMEs & Enterprises (2026)
summary: Compare 7 HR systems for Malaysian SMEs on EPF, SOCSO, PCB and LHDN forms, HRD Corp support and RM pricing, and find the right fit for 2026.
body_markdown:
Key Takeaways


- **Best all-in-one HRMS for growing teams:** brioHR is the strongest fit for SMEs and enterprises that want payroll, HR, performance, and reporting in one system.
- **Best payroll-first option for small teams:** PayrollPanda works well for companies that mainly need Malaysian payroll and statutory compliance.
- **Best for modern SME HR automation:** Swingvy is a solid option for teams that want a cleaner interface and simpler HR workflows.
- **Best for large enterprise complexity:** Darwinbox and Workday make more sense for larger organizations with bigger budgets, larger HR teams, and more complex rollout needs.
- **Best for day-to-day SME administration:** QuickHR is worth assessing for attendance, leave, claims and approvals; Malaysian statutory handling should be verified for the proposed package.


Payroll and compliance in Malaysia are not simple. Employers need to stay on top of EPF, SOCSO, EIS, and tax obligations, and those requirements create real pressure for small and growing teams.


In this guide, you’ll compare the top options, see where each one shines, and choose the right **HR system Malaysia** businesses can actually grow with.


💡


Did You Know?


Malaysia’s[RM1,700 monthly minimum wage](https://www.mohr.gov.my/index.php/ms/media-berita/kenyataan-media) applied nationwide from 1 August 2025. From wages for October 2025, eligible non-Malaysian employees and their employers generally contribute[2% each to EPF](https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/employer/responsibilities/non-malaysian-citizen-employees) , with exceptions such as permanent residents. These changes make current statutory calculations essential when choosing HR software.

## brioHR: All-in-One HRMS Software and Payroll Solution in Malaysia


brioHR is an all-in-one HRMS built for companies that want one system across the full employee lifecycle.


It covers[hire](https://briohr.com/products/recruitment-ats/) ,[onboard](https://briohr.com/products/products/onboarding/) ,[pay](https://briohr.com/products/payroll/) ,[manage](https://briohr.com/products/performance-management//) , and[develop](https://briohr.com/products/training-management-system/) , which makes it a strong fit for growing companies moving beyond spreadsheets or fragmented tools. That direction also matches brioHR’s brand positioning: reduce administrative noise, improve visibility, and help teams move from admin to impact.


### brioHR Key Features


brioHR is most useful when the same employee data needs to flow between onboarding, attendance, leave, claims and payroll. The three capabilities below are practical checks for a Malaysian HR team.


#### Connected Employee Lifecycle


The employee journey starts with[recruitment](https://briohr.com/products/recruitment-ats/) and[digital onboarding](https://briohr.com/products/products/onboarding/) , then continues into employee files, leave, performance and reporting. Keeping those records in one HRMS reduces duplicate entry and avoids chasing separate spreadsheets whenever a job role or reporting manager changes. A useful demo should show an approved employee change feeding through to the correct payroll record.


#### Malaysian Payroll and Statutory Workflows


brioHR connects[payroll](https://briohr.com/products/payroll/) with leave, attendance, and employee information. In Malaysia, that means checking the configuration for EPF, SOCSO, EIS and monthly tax deductions (PCB), alongside the required LHDN forms. Verify the actual downloadable reports, filing formats and approval steps for your plan; a system can calculate a contribution without automatically submitting it.


#### Workforce Visibility and Reporting


Managers need to understand why payroll changed, not just see the final amount. With connected[time and attendance](https://briohr.com/products/time-attendance/) ,[leave](https://briohr.com/products/products/leave-and-time-off/) ,[claims](https://briohr.com/products/products/expense-claims/) and[HR reporting](https://briohr.com/products/hr-reporting-software/) , teams can investigate exceptions sooner. ## How to Choose an HRMS for Malaysian Payroll and People Operations


Choose software by starting with local compliance, not the longest feature list. Ask providers to demonstrate three tasks using your payroll rules, staff types and approval policies.


### Malaysian Statutory Output and Payroll Readiness


Confirm the system calculates EPF, SOCSO, EIS and PCB and produces the required output files or forms. Since the RM1,700 minimum wage and the October 2025 EPF expansion, your payroll must handle wage thresholds and employee categories correctly. Ask who updates payroll rules, who submits payments and whether LHDN forms are available by plan.


In a[brioHR demo](https://briohr.com/book-demo/) , ask to trace an overtime or leave adjustment through payroll and the resulting statutory reports.


### Local Operations Before Regional Expansion


Do not buy a complex global platform if your immediate challenge is monthly payroll, shift schedules and leave approvals in Malaysia. Compare each vendor's local support hours, statutory documentation and employee access before paying for regional expansion features. If you have employees in several countries, also check legal-entity handling and approval delegation.


### Reporting That Explains Payroll Changes


Ask for a monthly reconciliation showing headcount, overtime, leave without pay and statutory deductions. Ideally HR and finance can see the same approved numbers without manual exports.[HR reporting tools](https://briohr.com/products/hr-reporting-software/) and a connected[digital employee file](https://briohr.com/products/digital-employee-file/) can help.


### Total Cost and Rollout Responsibility


Compare per-employee costs alongside setup, payroll modules, bank-file output, support and training. Request a written plan for who updates statutory rules and who signs off each payroll cycle. An inexpensive core HR tier is not necessarily the least expensive compliant payroll solution.


Pro Tip


Think six to twelve months ahead. The system that works for a 10-person team often breaks at 30. Choose a platform that can handle approvals, reporting, and cross-team visibility before you actually need it.

#### FAQs


** ** What are the top 10 HR software in Malaysia?


There is no universally correct top ten. This guide compares seven relevant options: brioHR, PayrollPanda, Swingvy, Kakitangan, Darwinbox, Workday and QuickHR. Prioritise Malaysian payroll coverage, pricing and company size.


** ** What is the best payroll software in Malaysia?


It depends on your needs. PayrollPanda suits payroll-first small teams, while brioHR suits companies wanting payroll connected to leave, claims, employee records and reporting. Verify current statutory exports.


** ** What software is best for an HR department?


An HR department usually benefits from software covering employee records, leave, attendance, payroll, approvals and reporting. The best fit depends on headcount, integration requirements and Malaysian statutory responsibilities.


** ** Does Malaysian HR software automatically submit EPF and PCB?


Not always. Calculating EPF or PCB deductions does not necessarily mean the system submits payments or returns. Ask the vendor to demonstrate the actual downloadable files and approval workflow.
